notes: S2-FIX4 F84 (decision 2026-11-16 #4; §14.9, §14.6): a human key declared in the container (cosigned by human-1) and a second declaration of it whose body.key is absent (the F84 mutant 151115/4256477586932129590 in this shape). Its actor.key signature cannot use material the record states for its own key, so it is verified against the first declaration's, which is context material: the check is context-trusted, N_KEY_TOFU on that record and L_KEY_TRUST_TOFU. The record is re-signed after body.key was removed, so both equations hold and the record fails its body schema (E_KIND_BODY_SCHEMA, after the signatures). The first declaration's own self-signature uses its own material and is not context-trusted.
